title: Recalibrating Many Questions with Few Labels: Minimax Rates and Identification Limits
abstract: arXiv:2610.18488v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many related prediction problems, which we call questions, come with few labels each. What information can be shared across them, and what is actually necessary for good decisions? We answer both for recalibration, motivated by decision models such as Jev (TypeSafe AI, 2026) that return a probability for any yes/no question a developer writes. A predictor reports a probability $P$ with output law $\mu$ on $m$ questions, each with $n$ labels and a nondecreasing map $g_j(p)=\mathbb{P}(Y=1\mid P=p)$; the compound risk is the excess Brier score over the true maps, averaged over questions. Over maps within sup-distance $\tau\le 1$ and total variation $V\le 2$ of one nondecreasing shape (fixed effects), the minimax compound risk is $(mn)^{-2/3}+\min\{\tau^2,1/n\}+\min\{\tau^2,V^2,(V/n)^{2/3}\}$ up to universal constants, for every non-atomic $\mu$. A pooled isotonic fit with a per-question correction sized once, on held-out labels of all que

translated_title: 少标签下多问题的再校准：极小极大速率与可辨识性极限
translated_abstract: 许多相关的预测问题（我们称之为“问题”），每个问题仅有少量标签。哪些信息可以在这些问题之间共享，而做出良好决策实际上又需要什么？我们针对再校准回答了这两个问题，其动机来自诸如 Jev（TypeSafe AI, 2026）之类的决策模型，该模型能对开发者编写的任意“是/否”问题返回一个概率。预测器在 m 个问题上报告概率 P，其输出分布为 μ，每个问题有 n 个标签和一个非递减映射 g_j(p)=P(Y=1|P=p)；复合风险定义为相对于真实映射的超额 Brier 分数在所有问题上的平均。当所有映射与某一非递减形状（固定效应）之间的上确界距离 τ ≤ 1、全变差 V ≤ 2 时，对任意非原子的 μ，极小极大复合风险在通用常数意义下为 (mn)^{-2/3} + min{τ², 1/n} + min{τ², V², (V/n)^{2/3}}。一种仅在所有问题的留出标签上单次定标、并带逐问题修正的合并等张回归拟合方法……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文针对每个问题仅有少量标签的多个相关预测问题，首次刻画了再校准的极小极大最优复合风险率与可辨识性极限，并给出了能共享信息、达到最优速率的合并等张回归估计方法。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the minimax-optimal compound risk rates and identification limits for recalibration across many related prediction questions with few labels each, showing what information can be shared and providing a pooled isotonic estimation method that attains the optimal rates.
